stock.description: Zhongshen Jianye Holding Limited operates as a comprehensive construction general contractor throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's diverse service portfolio includes fundamental structural and engineering endeavors, the development of urban and rural municipal and public infrastructure, and intricate foundation engineering such as earthwork, base construction, and slope protection. They also specialize in contracting services like building refurbishment and interior design. Furthermore, Zhongshen Jianye provides Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and project management expertise. Founded in 2017, the firm is headquartered in Shenzhen, PRC.
